title: Cartwise Rewards Tier Qualification Schedule
content:
Cartwise Rewards has six tiers — Member, Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum and Diamond — and each tier is held on the strength of the member's qualifying spend over the trailing 12 months. A tier is entered when that spend is at least the tier's minimum below.

## Schedule of tier figures

| Tier | Qualifying spend in the trailing 12 months, at least | Evaluation day of the month | Grace, in evaluations | Tiers lost per evaluation after grace |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cartwise Rewards Member | $0.00 | 1 | 0 | 1 |
| Cartwise Rewards Bronze | $500.00 | 1 | 1 | 1 |
| Cartwise Rewards Silver | $1500.00 | 1 | 2 | 1 |
| Cartwise Rewards Gold | $3000.00 | 1 | 2 | 1 |
| Cartwise Rewards Platinum | $6000.00 | 1 | 3 | 1 |
| Cartwise Rewards Diamond | $10000.00 | 1 | 3 | 1 |

**Timing of a promotion.** For every tier, a promotion takes effect at the evaluation itself.

## Reading the schedule

- **Minimum qualifying spend** is the amount of trailing 12-month qualifying spend a member needs to hold the tier; meeting it exactly ("at least") is enough.
- **Evaluation day** is the day of each month on which tiers are evaluated — the 1st of the month for every tier.
- **Grace** is the number of months (counted in evaluations) that a member keeps the tier after falling below its minimum spend.
- **Tiers lost per evaluation after grace** is how many tiers a member drops at an evaluation once grace is used up — one tier, for every tier.

## Tier thresholds on both sides (hypothetical spend figures)

| Hypothetical trailing 12-month qualifying spend | Highest tier whose minimum is met |
|---|---|
| $499.99 | Cartwise Rewards Member |
| $500.00 | Cartwise Rewards Bronze |
| $1499.99 | Cartwise Rewards Bronze |
| $1500.00 | Cartwise Rewards Silver |
| $2999.99 | Cartwise Rewards Silver |
| $3000.00 | Cartwise Rewards Gold |
| $5999.99 | Cartwise Rewards Gold |
| $6000.00 | Cartwise Rewards Platinum |
| $9999.99 | Cartwise Rewards Platinum |
| $10000.00 | Cartwise Rewards Diamond |

## Questions the schedule answers

**Which Cartwise Rewards tiers carry no grace?** Cartwise Rewards Member carries 0 months of grace. Bronze carries 1, Silver and Gold carry 2, and Platinum and Diamond carry 3.

**Does any tier drop more than one tier at a time after grace?** No. The figure for tiers lost per evaluation after grace is 1 at every tier.
